candidate.source_summary: The link destination is parsed from user input using parseLinkDestination, which extracts a string from the markdown source. The result is then validated using validateLink function.
candidate.sink_summary: The validated link destination is used to create an HTML <a> tag href attribute in the output.
candidate.guard_summary: The validation performed by validateLink checks if the URL has a bad protocol (javascript, vbscript, file) and returns false if it does. This is a basic protocol validation check.
candidate.risk_pattern: If validateLink were bypassed or weakened, an attacker could inject links with dangerous protocols like javascript: or file:, which could lead to XSS or local file inclusion vulnerabilities when rendered in HTML.
candidate.context_summary: This code is part of the link parsing logic in markdown-it. When parsing an inline link, it first parses the destination using parseLinkDestination and then validates it with validateLink before using it to create a hyperlink.
